name: Arnold Holdings Ltd.
about: Arnold Holdings Ltd. operates as a non-deposit-taking non-banking financial company in India. The company offers secured and unsecured business loan products comprising working capital loans, loans for proprietorship, infrastructure finance, and inter-corporate loans; secured and unsecured personal loan products consisting of Tradofina digital lending app for microfinance products, consumer durable loans, debt consolidation loans, and instant cash loans; commercial and private vehicle loans; education loans; loans against properties; and loans against shares. It also provides trade finance and bill discounting, margin funding, capital market, corporate finance, mortgage loans, and infrastructure finance. In addition, the company trades in shares and securities. It serves commercial, industrial, and financial clients, as well as SMEs, mid-corporate, and large corporate clients. Arnold Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
